From the Hanabi demo and a prior-art survey (Tinker, W&B, Lightning, prime-rl, ClearML), Jack Heart: "1a", "2a - but i still dont exactly undersatnd why/when we need to add the wraper", "3a". So: (1) save cadence is run.steps(clock, to=N, save_every=K) and save_every_seconds=S (Tinker's spellings); remove every= (Jack read it as a stride); default stays time-based. (2) run.steps("updates") declares its own step clock (label defaults to its name); track(clocks=[...]) is only needed for extra axes; a row logged before any clock exists is refused with a message saying to declare the clock or log inside run.steps. (3) rename run.stopping() to run.should_stop (Lightning's trainer.should_stop). Warning aliases only for released names. Whether Step(...) is needed at all for extra clocks is still being discussed: do not remove it yet. Words in scratch/demo-hanabi.md.
